Complete your member profile

Use your membership right away.

After activation, start with the actions that make your profile more recognizable, informative and useful to Franklin residents.

1 · Logo or profile image

Upload or manage the approved image that represents your business, then add eligible cover or gallery media.

Manage profile media

2 · Business information

Review your description, services, hours and supported website, contact or customer-action links.

Review profile details

3 · Promotions & events

Create a reviewed coupon, special, sale, promotion or event and add an eligible graphic, flyer image or reviewed PDF document.

Manage promotions & events

4 · Public preview

Preview the enhanced experience so you understand what residents can see and what remains subject to review.

Preview member profile

Community Membership does not replace free profile rights. Claiming, factual corrections, removal requests and legitimate free-profile management remain free.

Promotional images use the reviewed image workflow. Reviewed PDF flyers/documents up to 4 MB and 20 pages are supported; active, encrypted, embedded-file and form-like PDFs are rejected.
